notes.subject: קדוש הוא
notes.rationale: 'Hol i em' — man i tok long Nem (holi Nem) o long Yahwe yet (em i holi); vers 5 i kamap lain long em.

notes.subject: stingim tok
notes.rationale: יודה i min 'autim tingting gutpela long nem' — Tok Pisin 'stingim tok bilong' i klostu tasol i no wankain piksa.

translation: Ol bai stingim tok bilong nem bilong yu — i bikpela man tru na i tingim ol man long bikpela fright — holi em i stap.

tokens.gloss: na i tingim ol man long bikpela fright
